## 5001 - 5036

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="05001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />5001 VAR - Percent variance high ethane (C2) GPM</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="05001">

This exception is generated on a gas quality source for each sample that has the Ethane C2 GPM value that varies from the value calculated by FLOWCAL by more than the Percent limit set in the Variance validations for the quality source. For example, the current sample has Ethane C2 GPM value of 3.8624. Ethane C2 GPM calculated by FLOWCAL based on the sample values is 3.8597. The limit defined in Variance validation is 0.05%. Since the current value differs from the calculated value by abs(3.8624 / 3.8597 – 1) \* 100 = 0.0699%, which is greater than 0.05%, this exception is generated.

</div>
